title: Indirect questions + tags
recall: Indirect savolda so'z tartibi qanday? Question tag qanday yasaladi, I'm va Let's bilan nima bo'ladi?
formula: Could you tell me / Do you know + savol so'zi + EGA + FE'L — Do you know where the station is?
yes/no savol: if / whether — I wonder if he's coming
tag: tasdiq → inkor tag (You're coming, aren't you?); I'm → aren't I; Let's → shall we; imperative → will you

pairs.b: Could you tell me where the station is?

pairs.a: Do you know what time is it? ❌
pairs.b: Do you know what time it is?

en: Could you tell me where the station is?
Can you tell me where the station is?
Do you know what time it is?
I don't know if he's coming.
I don't know whether he is coming or not.
I don't know whether he's coming.
Could you tell me how much this costs?
Can you tell me how much this is?
I didn't understand what he meant.
I don't understand what he means.
I wonder where he lives.
I wonder where she lives.
You're coming tomorrow, aren't you?
You'll come tomorrow, won't you?
She isn't a doctor, is she?
He isn't a doctor, is he?
I'm right, aren't I?
Let's start, shall we?
Let's begin, shall we?
You've seen this film, haven't you?
You've seen this movie, haven't you?
He didn't come yesterday, did he?
She didn't come yesterday, did she?
Close the door, will you?
Shut the door, will you?

items.uz: Bu yaqin atrofda bank bormi, bilasizmi?
en: Do you know if there's a bank near here?
Do you know whether there is a bank nearby?
Could you tell me who came?
Can you tell me who has arrived?
I don't know why she's upset.
I don't know why he was upset.
I don't know why she is upset.
You speak English, don't you?
It isn't very expensive, is it?
This isn't too expensive, is it?
Do you know when the meeting starts?
Do you know what time the meeting starts?
He can drive, can't he?
She can drive, can't she?

speak: Notanish shaharda 5 ta muloyim savol bering (Could you tell me…).
Do'stingizga 5 ta question tag bilan gap ayting.
Nimani bilmaysiz va qiziqasiz? (I wonder…, I don't know if…)
